summary: This March 2026 asymmetry lecture is already-public Game Theory support for identifying the real game and reward, while adding broader Strategy, Iran, Eschatology, Attention, and Prediction pressure: imperial advantages invert into weaknesses, Iran is tested by energy/openness/cohesion, and material war motives may be displaced by apocalyptic or consciousness rewards.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The game analysts think actors are playing may not be the game they are playing; material prizes may be displaced by religious destiny, martyrdom, humiliation, or consciousness control.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Game Theory page already cites this source in the real-game lens point and in the late section on non-material prizes.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Pressure can backfire by turning internal opponents into a cohesive society, activating Persian historical memory, and making bombing or minority arming strengthen rather than break Iran.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Iran As Pressure Point anchor already owns pressure hardening will. This source is a strong future ref candidate, but this intake does not edit public prose or episode read JSON.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The stronger side's technology, propaganda, and money can become dependence, self-intoxication, and bad mercenary incentives, while the weaker side wins by setting terrain, duration, morale, and pain surfaces.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Strategy page already carries the dominance/control family. This March 5 lecture is a predecessor to the March 10 Control Beats Dominance source, but it should feed compression or review rather than create a duplicate child page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the hard correction to material-only game theory. Jiang's warning that analysts may have named the wrong game lets the page handle religious destiny, martyrdom, humiliation, and consciousness control as possible rewards without abandoning player/rule/incentive discipline.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns the method of asking which game and reward are actually active. Eschatology owns sacred role-script when the reward is end-times participation; Attention and Power own consciousness or money only when those become the active mechanism.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as Strategy pressure if the dominance/control section is next compressed: imperial mass, organization, and expendability invert into debt, elite overproduction, insularity, and hubris; technology, propaganda, and money likewise invert into dependence, censored debate, and untrustworthy bought proxies.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns asymmetry when it is a material-war audit of capacity, terrain, logistics, morale, duration, and adaptation. Game Theory owns the general rule/reward method; Iran As Pressure Point owns Iran-specific transmission across systems.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as strong future Iran compression support: Jiang's live criterion is whether bombing and pressure make Iran energetic, open, cohesive, resilient, and united. The lecture ties this to Shia martyrdom, mountain terrain, Persian civilizational nationalism, urban-rural cohesion, and long memory activated by external attack.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Iran As Pressure Point owns the Iran-specific hardening and transmission mechanism. Nation owns general nationalism only when the national machine is primary; Eschatology owns Shia faith only when sacred role-script becomes the active reward.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as background pressure for Iran's hide-and-seek war and occupation trap: Iran can absorb bombing in mountains, create recurring economic pain through drones and rockets, and tempt America into an invasion Jiang treats as proof it has lost.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: No-Exit War owns the invasion/occupation threshold and exit-cost ladder. Chokepoint owns route and access mechanics. This source's primary public home remains Game Theory and Strategy unless a later Iran compression needs the exact hide-and-seek image.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Armageddon and war-for-Jesus material as caveated eschatology pressure only. Jiang presents a reported military email and explicitly marks apocalyptic Christians in government or the military as a possible explanation, not a proven fact.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns sacred role-script and apocalyptic reward only with attribution and caveats. Prediction owns dated event status; Game Theory owns the methodological point that the reward may not be material.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the final consciousness thesis as future Attention/Power comparison pressure: Jiang says money is not the real currency, human consciousness is, because consciousness creates reality and World War III is fought for the soul of humanity.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention owns focused consciousness as living wealth; Power owns conversion and storage machinery; Eschatology owns soul-war language when it becomes sacred role-script. This single closing move should not reopen the recently compressed Attention page by itself.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Queue separate dated March 5, 2026 forecast branches before any ledger scoring: the United States will lose the U.S.-Iran war; Iran wins if it becomes energetic, open, cohesive, resilient, and united; American strategy will rely on ethnic fracture, decapitation, and soft targeting; ground invasion means America has lost.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns date, horizon, branch split, later comparison, and falsifiers. Do not score the whole March 5 lecture as one Iran-war prediction.

new_lens_seeds.title: Law Of Asymmetry
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: The stronger actor's advantages can become weaknesses when mass, organization, technology, propaganda, money, and expendability produce debt, elite overproduction, hubris, dependency, censored debate, and low political will, while the weaker actor turns energy, openness, cohesion, terrain, memory, and existential stakes into control of the game.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can compare Iran, Operation True Promise, later control-beats-dominance sources, borderland pressure, and imperial decline cases where apparent advantage creates the condition of defeat.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed, not a standalone page now. The active public homes can still carry it: Game Theory for rule/reward method, Strategy for material war asymmetry, Iran for the specific pressure point, and Borderland for margin-energy cases.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-03-05, this lecture sits between the earlier 2024 Operation True Promise asymmetry source and the 2026-03-10 Control Beats Dominance lecture. It gives the empire-scale inversion model that later becomes the sharper control/dominance rule.

The March 5, 2026 source predates the March 10 and March 12 classroom Iran-war records and should remain a separate branch set: U.S. loss, Iran's social-transformation criterion, ethnic-fracture/decapitation strategy, and ground invasion as a losing threshold.

This source explicitly escalates from U.S.-Iran asymmetry to a larger course thesis: possible apocalyptic war motives, the need to identify non-material rewards, and human consciousness as the real currency and battlefield.

promotion_requirements: Split U.S.-loss, Iran-social-transformation, ethnic-fracture strategy, decapitation/soft-targeting, and ground-invasion-threshold claims before scoring.
